mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO seller_balance_flow (account_id, seller_id, tenant_id, settlement_id, refund_id, withdraw_id, type, amount, balance_after, biz_key, create_time) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{sellerId}, #{tenantId}, #{settlementId}, #{refundId}, #{withdrawId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{balanceAfter}, #{bizKey}, NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM seller_balance_flow WHERE account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT flow_id, account_id, seller_id, tenant_id, settlement_id, refund_id, withdraw_id, type, amount, balance_after, biz_key, create_time FROM seller_balance_flow WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY flow_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.seller_id AS sellerId, a.tenant_id AS tenantId, a.balance AS balance, COALESCE(SUM(f.amount), 0) AS flowSum FROM seller_account a LEFT JOIN seller_balance_flow f ON f.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, a.seller_id, a.tenant_id, a.balance HAVING a.balance <> COALESCE(SUM(f.amount), 0) LIMIT 1000

SELECT a.account_id AS accountId, a.seller_id AS sellerId, a.tenant_id AS tenantId, a.balance AS balance, f.balance_after AS lastBalance FROM seller_account a JOIN seller_balance_flow f ON f.flow_id = ( SELECT f2.flow_id FROM seller_balance_flow f2 WHERE f2.account_id = a.account_id ORDER BY f2.flow_id DESC LIMIT 1 ) WHERE a.balance <> f.balance_after LIMIT 1000
